decisions.label: See-through reach
decisions.note: How far past her the soft see-through circle reaches, a share of her size (occlusion.edge, 0.8 as ever). If the circle bug's ring grows and shrinks with this, the ring is the see-through's own edge (Ed, 2026-10-14).

decisions.label: See-through opacity
decisions.note: How solid things in front of her stay at the circle's middle (occlusion.fadeOpacity, 0.38 as ever; 1: not see-through at all, though still drawn in the see-through pass).

decisions.label: See-through fade
decisions.note: Off: things in front of her stay solid and in the solid pass (the fade alone off; everything else of the see-through as ever). On as ever.

decisions.label: Mark see-through pixels
decisions.note: On: every pixel the see-through pass draws tinted magenta, to see whether the circle bug's ring is exactly that pass's edge. Off as ever.

decisions.label: Low mist
decisions.note: The low drifting mist (part of the smooth effects layer). On as ever; off to see if the circle round her goes (Ed, 2026-10-14).

decisions.label: Light rings
decisions.note: The faint moonlight rings on the crowns (part of the smooth effects layer). On as ever; off to see if the circle round her goes (Ed, 2026-10-14).

decisions.label: See-through depth order
decisions.note: On: where two faded things in front of her overlap, the nearer wins, as everywhere else (the see-through pass writes depth as it draws). Off as ever: whichever is drawn last wins, nearer or not (Ed, 2026-10-14).

decisions.label: See-through skipping
decisions.note: On as ever: the see-through pass skips whole sprites it reckons can't reach her circle. Off: it draws them all and each pixel decides (slower). If the circle goes when this is off, the skip and the pixels disagree and pixels fall between the passes (Ed, 2026-10-14).

decisions.label: Keep solid copy
decisions.note: On: the solid pass draws what's in front of her as well, and the see-through pass over it (nothing is see-through then). If the circle's edge goes, it came from what showed through the gap the solid pass left; if it stays, from the see-through pass's own drawing (Ed, 2026-10-14).

decisions.label: See-through marks
decisions.note: On: the see-through pass marks the trees it draws in the stencil, as the solid pass does (the marks the ley line shows through). Off as ever (Ed, 2026-10-14).

decisions.label: See-through drawn early
decisions.note: On: the see-through pass drawn straight after the solid trees, not after everything else (a test: she then shows through them whole). If the circle's edge goes, something drawn between changes the trees (Ed, 2026-10-14).

decisions.label: See-through solid
decisions.note: On: the see-through pass draws its pixels fully solid, with no blending (a test: nothing is see-through then). If the circle's edge goes, it's the blending (Ed, 2026-10-14).
